_about: Curated tags per meta deck for tags.js (RESEARCH-ARCHETYPES-PROFILES-13OCT.md): the two tags no rule derives. finisher = ends the game from a stable board, whatever its card type; combo-piece = part of the deck's named win, with role. Keyed by deck name as the field names it; a card in a deck's list that appears here gets the tag on top of the derived ones. Lists read 13 Oct 2026 from June–Aug 2026 top-8 lists; Code should confirm against the live field lists on the NAS (names in the field may differ from these).

_generic.finisher: any card whose text says 'you win the game' or 'loses the game', any spell or permanent that deals 5+ damage to a player or each opponent, any creature or planeswalker with mana value >= 5, and anything listed below
_generic.combo-piece: only from the lists below; never derived

4c Control.notes: Wins by resolving Jeskai Revelation, then recasting it with Flashback; Tablet of Discovery makes the turn-five Revelation. North Wind Avatar is the one creature; Riverchurn Monument (sideboard) wins by mill. Day of Judgment is the sweeper; Inevitable Defeat, Sear, Lightning Helix, Firebending Lesson the answers; No More Lies / Negate / Together as One the counters; Stock Up and Consult the Star Charts the selection. Plan: tap-out control (sweepers into a finisher), with a draw-go turn when it holds No More Lies.

combo-piece.role: engine: exiles both libraries down to six
finish: attacks mill the opponent's last cards so their draw step loses
copy: a second Excruciator effect or body

Dimir Excruciator.notes: Interaction (Requiting Hex, Bitter Triumph, Deadly Cover-Up, Duress, Day of Black Sun) until Excruciator is castable with the opponent unable to answer; then Reef attacks for the empty-library win. Plan: disrupt-and-clock until the finish, library attack for one turn. The logs read it as midrange (3% of turns holding a castable card), which is right for how Forge plays it; the profile is disrupt-and-clock with the library-attack finisher rule.

combo-piece.role: airbend: re-casts a permanent from exile for {2}
airbends any number of your permanents; an Ally token per spell cast from exile
mana only for spells cast from exile
counts creatures entering; flickers one at end step

Bant Airbending.notes: Re-curated 14 Oct 2026 from the live list (research's names, NOTE-TO-CODE-13OCT-ENGINE-REVIEW.md) and checked against 296 logged games (tools/combo-pieces.js, design/combo-pieces-bant.json). The log cannot confirm the pieces, because Forge does not play the combo: only 17% of Bant's wins cast 3+ spells on the winning turn, the median win is turn 8, and no card reaches the 80% (piece) or 60% (enabler) bar. It wins as a flash-flier creature deck, which is why the sim rates it 51% against the field while real players see 22%. Forge never casts Airbender Ascension (in hand 837 times, cast 0): a dead card for the dead-card list. Plan: fast combo by its name.

combo-piece.role: engine: free spells, wins the same turn

Temur Omniscience.notes: Pieces that cheat Omniscience into play and the win line vary by list; Code: fill from the live field list. Plan: fast combo.

Azorius Control.notes: Finishers derive (creatures/planeswalkers with MV >= 5); no curated entry needed unless the live list wins with a noncreature (a Monument, a lesson). Plan: draw-go.

Mardu Discard.notes: discard-as-value; Marauding Mako and Moonshadow grow on discard; Cool but Rude is the damage finish (per Karsten). Confirm names against the live list.
